articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Is BlackRock (BLK) Starting To Look Expensive After Its Strong Multi Year Share Price Run?. If you are wondering whether BlackRock's recent share price puts it on your watchlist or on the expensive side, it helps to look closely at what you are paying for each dollar of its business today. BlackRock's stock last closed at US$1,112.28, with returns of 2.7% over the past week, 3.7% over the past month, 2.5% year to date, 15.7% over 1 year, 57.9% over 3 years and 61.2% over 5 years, which gives plenty of context before you weigh up what is a fair price.
